tablet.notes:
Conversations look like Google Messages: messages in a row from the same person are stacked closely with squared inner corners, so each run reads as one sender, with more room between different senders.
Since the last update: searching on the conversation list highlights the word and opens the chat with its matches; group chats show their unread state.
